errors.text_span: This pie chart represents an error analysis of responses generated by two models
errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate pie charts, but the description incorrectly refers to the entire figure as a single "pie chart".

errors.text_span: an error analysis of responses generated by two models, labeled “Atomic Skill Fail” and “Correct,” alongside “Reason Error” and “Question Misunderstood.”
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous and incorrect. It implies the models are named after the outcome categories, rather than these categories representing the analysis breakdown for each of two distinct models (Vanilla and HCL, per the provided caption).

errors.text_span: each representing a type of error observed in the models' responses.
errors.evidence: The category "Correct" is one of the four categories listed and shown, but it is not a type of error.

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored in a light teal, represents “Atomic Skill Fail”
errors.evidence: The color for “Atomic Skill Fail” is dark teal, not light teal. Light teal corresponds to “Reason Error”.

errors.text_span: the second largest slice, colored in a medium teal, displays “Correct” with approximately 21.0%.
errors.evidence: The value for “Correct” is 55.0% in the right chart and 12.0% in the left chart. The value 21.0% corresponds to the “Reason Error” category in the right chart.

errors.text_span: A smaller slice colored in a light gray represents “Reason Error,” with approximately 14.0%
errors.evidence: The category “Reason Error” does not have a value of 14.0%; this value corresponds to “Question Misunderstood” in the right chart. Furthermore, the color for “Reason Error” is light teal, not light gray.

errors.text_span: the smallest slice colored in a light lavender represents “Question Misunderstood” with approximately 10.0%.
errors.evidence: The category “Question Misunderstood” does not have a value of 10.0%; this value corresponds to “Atomic Skill Fail” in the right chart. The values for “Question Misunderstood” are 8.0% (left) and 14.0% (right).
The color "light lavender" is not used in the chart. The slice for "Question Misunderstood" is white.
A legend is clearly visible at the top of the figure, defining the four categories and their colors.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their size.
errors.evidence: This is only true for the pie chart on the right. The slices in the left pie chart are not ordered by size (68.0%, 12.0%, 12.0%, 8.0%).
